Description: Minute Book — AppSync + DynamoDB backend (Cognito user-pool auth).

UserPoolId.Description: Existing Cognito user pool id to authorize the API.

CognitoRegion.Description: Region of the Cognito user pool.

Properties.Definition:
type CorpInfo {
  id: ID!
  legalName: String
  tradeNames: [String]
  corporationNumber: String
  businessNumber: String
  jurisdiction: String
  incorporationDate: AWSDate
  registeredOffice: String
  mailingAddress: String
  createdAt: AWSDateTime
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime
}
type CorpInfoConnection {
  items: [CorpInfo!]!
  nextToken: String
}
input CreateCorpInfoInput {
  id: ID
  legalName: String
  tradeNames: [String]
  corporationNumber: String
  businessNumber: String
  jurisdiction: String
  incorporationDate: AWSDate
  registeredOffice: String
  mailingAddress: String
}
input UpdateCorpInfoInput {
  id: ID!
  legalName: String
  tradeNames: [String]
  corporationNumber: String
  businessNumber: String
  jurisdiction: String
  incorporationDate: AWSDate
  registeredOffice: String
  mailingAddress: String
}
input DeleteCorpInfoInput {
  id: ID!
}

type Director {
  id: ID!
  name: String
  address: String
  titles: [String]
  appointmentDate: AWSDate
  isSoleDirector: Boolean
  createdAt: AWSDateTime
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime
}
type DirectorConnection {
  items: [Director!]!
  nextToken: String
}
input CreateDirectorInput {
  id: ID
  name: String
  address: String
  titles: [String]
  appointmentDate: AWSDate
  isSoleDirector: Boolean
}
input UpdateDirectorInput {
  id: ID!
  name: String
  address: String
  titles: [String]
  appointmentDate: AWSDate
  isSoleDirector: Boolean
}
input DeleteDirectorInput {
  id: ID!
}

type ShareClass {
  id: ID!
  className: String
  authorized: Int
  issued: Int
  rightsRestrictions: String
  createdAt: AWSDateTime
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime
}
type ShareClassConnection {
  items: [ShareClass!]!
  nextToken: String
}
input CreateShareClassInput {
  id: ID
  className: String
  authorized: Int
  issued: Int
  rightsRestrictions: String
}
input UpdateShareClassInput {
  id: ID!
  className: String
  authorized: Int
  issued: Int
  rightsRestrictions: String
}
input DeleteShareClassInput {
  id: ID!
}

type Shareholder {
  id: ID!
  name: String
  shareClassId: ID
  quantity: Int
  certificateNumber: String
  createdAt: AWSDateTime
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime
}
type ShareholderConnection {
  items: [Shareholder!]!
  nextToken: String
}
input CreateShareholderInput {
  id: ID
  name: String
  shareClassId: ID
  quantity: Int
  certificateNumber: String
}
input UpdateShareholderInput {
  id: ID!
  name: String
  shareClassId: ID
  quantity: Int
  certificateNumber: String
}
input DeleteShareholderInput {
  id: ID!
}

type BankingInfo {
  id: ID!
  bankName: String
  branchAddress: String
  signingOfficers: [String]
  accountTypes: [String]
  createdAt: AWSDateTime
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime
}
type BankingInfoConnection {
  items: [BankingInfo!]!
  nextToken: String
}
input CreateBankingInfoInput {
  id: ID
  bankName: String
  branchAddress: String
  signingOfficers: [String]
  accountTypes: [String]
}
input UpdateBankingInfoInput {
  id: ID!
  bankName: String
  branchAddress: String
  signingOfficers: [String]
  accountTypes: [String]
}
input DeleteBankingInfoInput {
  id: ID!
}

type AnnualResolution {
  id: ID!
  fiscalYearCovered: String
  financialStatementsApproved: Boolean
  directorContinuation: Boolean
  dividendDeclared: Boolean
  dividendAmount: Float
  dividendClass: String
  auditWaiver: Boolean
  dateSigned: AWSDate
  pdfGenerated: Boolean
  createdAt: AWSDateTime
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime
}
type AnnualResolutionConnection {
  items: [AnnualResolution!]!
  nextToken: String
}
input CreateAnnualResolutionInput {
  id: ID
  fiscalYearCovered: String
  financialStatementsApproved: Boolean
  directorContinuation: Boolean
  dividendDeclared: Boolean
  dividendAmount: Float
  dividendClass: String
  auditWaiver: Boolean
  dateSigned: AWSDate
  pdfGenerated: Boolean
}
input UpdateAnnualResolutionInput {
  id: ID!
  fiscalYearCovered: String
  financialStatementsApproved: Boolean
  directorContinuation: Boolean
  dividendDeclared: Boolean
  dividendAmount: Float
  dividendClass: String
  auditWaiver: Boolean
  dateSigned: AWSDate
  pdfGenerated: Boolean
}
input DeleteAnnualResolutionInput {
  id: ID!
}

type AdHocResolution {
  id: ID!
  type: String
  customTitle: String
  date: AWSDate
  details: String
  dateSigned: AWSDate
  pdfGenerated: Boolean
  createdAt: AWSDateTime
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime
}
type AdHocResolutionConnection {
  items: [AdHocResolution!]!
  nextToken: String
}
input CreateAdHocResolutionInput {
  id: ID
  type: String
  customTitle: String
  date: AWSDate
  details: String
  dateSigned: AWSDate
  pdfGenerated: Boolean
}
input UpdateAdHocResolutionInput {
  id: ID!
  type: String
  customTitle: String
  date: AWSDate
  details: String
  dateSigned: AWSDate
  pdfGenerated: Boolean
}
input DeleteAdHocResolutionInput {
  id: ID!
}

type DocumentRegistryEntry {
  id: ID!
  documentId: ID
  documentType: String
  periodCovered: String
  dateSigned: AWSDate
  pdfGenerated: Boolean
  createdAt: AWSDateTime
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime
}
type DocumentRegistryEntryConnection {
  items: [DocumentRegistryEntry!]!
  nextToken: String
}
input CreateDocumentRegistryEntryInput {
  id: ID
  documentId: ID
  documentType: String
  periodCovered: String
  dateSigned: AWSDate
  pdfGenerated: Boolean
}
input UpdateDocumentRegistryEntryInput {
  id: ID!
  documentId: ID
  documentType: String
  periodCovered: String
  dateSigned: AWSDate
  pdfGenerated: Boolean
}
input DeleteDocumentRegistryEntryInput {
  id: ID!
}

type Query {
  getCorpInfo(id: ID!): CorpInfo
  listCorpInfos(limit: Int, nextToken: String): CorpInfoConnection
  getDirector(id: ID!): Director
  listDirectors(limit: Int, nextToken: String): DirectorConnection
  getShareClass(id: ID!): ShareClass
  listShareClasses(limit: Int, nextToken: String): ShareClassConnection
  getShareholder(id: ID!): Shareholder
  listShareholders(limit: Int, nextToken: String): ShareholderConnection
  getBankingInfo(id: ID!): BankingInfo
  listBankingInfos(limit: Int, nextToken: String): BankingInfoConnection
  getAnnualResolution(id: ID!): AnnualResolution
  listAnnualResolutions(limit: Int, nextToken: String): AnnualResolutionConnection
  getAdHocResolution(id: ID!): AdHocResolution
  listAdHocResolutions(limit: Int, nextToken: String): AdHocResolutionConnection
  getDocumentRegistryEntry(id: ID!): DocumentRegistryEntry
  listDocumentRegistryEntries(limit: Int, nextToken: String): DocumentRegistryEntryConnection
}

type Mutation {
  createCorpInfo(input: CreateCorpInfoInput!): CorpInfo
  updateCorpInfo(input: UpdateCorpInfoInput!): CorpInfo
  deleteCorpInfo(input: DeleteCorpInfoInput!): CorpInfo
  createDirector(input: CreateDirectorInput!): Director
  updateDirector(input: UpdateDirectorInput!): Director
  deleteDirector(input: DeleteDirectorInput!): Director
  createShareClass(input: CreateShareClassInput!): ShareClass
  updateShareClass(input: UpdateShareClassInput!): ShareClass
  deleteShareClass(input: DeleteShareClassInput!): ShareClass
  createShareholder(input: CreateShareholderInput!): Shareholder
  updateShareholder(input: UpdateShareholderInput!): Shareholder
  deleteShareholder(input: DeleteShareholderInput!): Shareholder
  createBankingInfo(input: CreateBankingInfoInput!): BankingInfo
  updateBankingInfo(input: UpdateBankingInfoInput!): BankingInfo
  deleteBankingInfo(input: DeleteBankingInfoInput!): BankingInfo
  createAnnualResolution(input: CreateAnnualResolutionInput!): AnnualResolution
  updateAnnualResolution(input: UpdateAnnualResolutionInput!): AnnualResolution
  deleteAnnualResolution(input: DeleteAnnualResolutionInput!): AnnualResolution
  createAdHocResolution(input: CreateAdHocResolutionInput!): AdHocResolution
  updateAdHocResolution(input: UpdateAdHocResolutionInput!): AdHocResolution
  deleteAdHocResolution(input: DeleteAdHocResolutionInput!): AdHocResolution
  createDocumentRegistryEntry(input: CreateDocumentRegistryEntryInput!): DocumentRegistryEntry
  updateDocumentRegistryEntry(input: UpdateDocumentRegistryEntryInput!): DocumentRegistryEntry
  deleteDocumentRegistryEntry(input: DeleteDocumentRegistryEntryInput!): DocumentRegistryEntry
}

schema {
  query: Query
  mutation: Mutation
}

GraphQLApiUrl.Description: AppSync GraphQL endpoint — put this in MB_APPSYNC_ENDPOINT / config.appsync.endpoint.

Region.Description: Region the API is deployed in (for config.appsync.region).
